responsibility: NVPTX offload image construction tool invoked by GCC’s offloading driver pipeline. It locates and runs the nvptx offload compiler, manages temporary files and environment variables, captures OpenMP requires metadata, reads the generated PTX assembly, parses compiler-emitted identifier records, and rewrites the PTX into a C source file embedding the device image and associated symbol metadata before compiling that host object for libgomp/offload registration.
